implementationSummary:
Issue #858: Rising cancellations must read as a problem, not a success.

## What was implemented

1. Added GoalDirection type ("higher-is-better" | "lower-is-better") to main-kpis.ts
2. Added required goalDirection field to MainKpiDefinition interface
3. Populated goalDirection for all 5 KPIs:
   - gmv-tiktok: higher-is-better
   - aov: higher-is-better
   - ctor: higher-is-better
   - live-hours: higher-is-better
   - cancellation-rate: lower-is-better (only one)
4. Created resolveToneFromDeltaAndGoal() as the single tone resolver:
   - Takes percentage change and goal direction
   - Returns semantic tone (positive/negative/neutral)
   - Higher-is-better: rise→positive, fall→negative
   - Lower-is-better: rise→negative, fall→positive
   - Zero change always→neutral
5. Updated computeDelta() to accept optional metricKey:
   - When metricKey provided, uses resolver for goal-aware tone
   - Arrow always reflects raw movement (▲/▼ based on pct direction)
   - When metricKey not provided (supplementary charts), uses raw movement tone
6. Updated buildLiveKpiSnapshot to pass metricKey to computeDelta
7. Refactored buildImpactMetricSnapshot to use unified resolver
   - Removed impactSentiment() function (duplicate logic absorbed into resolver)
   - Now computes both trend (raw movement) and sentiment (goal-aware)
8. Created comprehensive tests:
   - tone-resolver.test.ts: 10 tests covering both goal directions × rise/fall/zero + edge cases
   - Added 15 integration tests to envelope-mapper.test.ts
   - All tests assert rendered tone, not internal enum

## Acceptance criteria met

✓ Every KPI definition declares goalDirection; field is required (type error if omitted)
✓ Rising cancellation rate resolves to negative tone
✓ Falling cancellation rate resolves to positive tone
✓ Rising GMV/AOV/CTOR/LIVE hours resolve to positive tone
✓ Zero delta resolves to neutral for every KPI
✓ Arrow glyph still reflects raw movement only
✓ Tone derived in exactly one place (resolveToneFromDeltaAndGoal)
✓ Tests cover 6+ cases: both goal directions × rise/fall/zero, plus edge cases

## Files changed

- apps/demo/src/lib/analytics/main-kpis.ts (2 edits: type + definitions)
- apps/demo/src/lib/analytics/envelope-mapper.ts (4 edits: imports + resolver + computeDelta refactor + buildImpactMetricSnapshot refactor)
- apps/demo/src/lib/analytics/__tests__/envelope-mapper.test.ts (1 edit: add 15 integration tests)
- apps/demo/src/lib/analytics/__tests__/tone-resolver.test.ts (new file: 10 resolver unit tests)
assumptions: GoalDirection is a simple literal union type with no additional runtime behavior
Arrow glyph should always reflect raw movement direction, not goal-aware tone
Supplementary charts (product_funnel, live_performance) do not have goal directions and should use raw movement tone
All five Main KPIs fit into the two goal direction categories (four higher-is-better, one lower-is-better)
risks: No runtime risk: type system enforces goalDirection presence on all new KPIs
Behavioral change on analytics display: cancellation-rate rising now shows problem color instead of success color (intentional per spec)
The resolved tone is now used everywhere instead of raw-sign-based derivation, making the system more coherent
